gaps: the plan has the vendor send GET /v1/trade/{{tradeId}}/event_indicators, but the vendor's session may not call GET /v1/trade/:id/event_indicators (trade#event_indicators is not on that app's list in config/app_auth_config.yml)
warnings: verify 1: read_indicators's reply shape has not been sampled; "auction_identifiers_data.{{vendorUuid}}.inline.{{lineItemUuid}}.rank.best_bidder" is unverified

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFP + RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted its technical response; rounds still open.
steps: The invited QA vendor reads the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder).
As the invited QA vendor, read the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder) and check that “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 1 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” is present.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 1 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” is present.
